Detection of PowerShell Execution via Sqlps.exe This rule detects execution of a PowerShell code through the sqlps.exe utility, which is included in the standard set of utilities supplied with the MSSQL Server.
Script blocks are not logged in this case, so this utility helps to bypass protection mechanisms based on the analysis of these logs.
 {"category": "process_creation", "product": "windows"} {"condition": "selection_parent or (selection_image and not filter_image)", "filter_image": {"ParentImage|endswith": "\\sqlagent.exe"}, "selection_image": [{"Image|endswith": "\\sqlps.exe"}, {"OriginalFileName": "sqlps.exe"}], "selection_parent": {"ParentImage|endswith": "\\sqlps.exe"}} ["attack.execution", "attack.stealth", "attack.t1059.001", "attack.t1127"]

IIS WebServer Log Deletion via CommandLine Utilities Detects attempts to delete Internet Information Services (IIS) log files via command line utilities, which is a common defense evasion technique used by attackers to cover their tracks.
Threat actors often abuse vulnerabilities in web applications hosted on IIS servers to gain initial access and later delete IIS logs to evade detection.
 {"category": "process_creation", "product": "windows"} {"condition": "all of selection_*", "selection_cli_del": {"CommandLine|contains": ["del ", "erase ", "rm ", "remove-item ", "rmdir "]}, "selection_cli_iis_dir": {"CommandLine|contains": "\\inetpub\\logs\\"}, "selection_img": [{"Image|endswith": ["\\cmd.exe", "\\powershell_ise.exe", "\\powershell.exe", "\\pwsh.exe"]}, {"OriginalFileName": ["cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "powershell_ise.exe", "pwsh.dll"]}]} ["attack.stealth", "attack.t1070"]

Remote Access Tool - Anydesk Execution From Suspicious Folder An adversary may use legitimate desktop support and remote access software, such as Team Viewer, Go2Assist, LogMein, AmmyyAdmin, etc, to establish an interactive command and control channel to target systems within networks.
These services are commonly used as legitimate technical support software, and may be allowed by application control within a target environment.
Remote access tools like VNC, Ammyy, and Teamviewer are used frequently when compared with other legitimate software commonly used by adversaries. (Citation: Symantec Living off the Land)
 {"category": "process_creation", "product": "windows"} {"condition": "selection and not filter", "filter": {"Image|contains": ["\\AppData\\", "Program Files (x86)\\AnyDesk", "Program Files\\AnyDesk"]}, "selection": [{"Image|endswith": ["\\AnyDesk.exe", "\\AnyDeskMSI.exe"]}, {"Description": "AnyDesk"}, {"Product": "AnyDesk"}, {"Company": "AnyDesk Software GmbH"}]} ["attack.command-and-control", "attack.t1219.002"]

to spoof Service Principal Names (SPNs) and redirect authentication requests like in CVE-2025-33073.
